notes: Idea: concrete-maturity mix calibration. Implemented the ASTM C1074 annex procedure (per-temperature k by the 1/S line or a least-squares hyperbola, datum from k vs T, E from ln k vs 1/T, standard errors) and a third estimator not in the annex: the datum/E minimising scatter of all cubes about one curve. Monte Carlo on synthetic Arrhenius cubes (E=42 kJ/mol, 10/23/38 C, 200 sets x 3 noise levels x setting given/not): single-curve SD of E 2.4-5.7x smaller; annex k-line datum (~4.5 C) collapsed cubes worse than the 0 C default at every noise level (260 vs 210 psi at 3%), single-curve datum (~2 C) better than both. Synthetic only; next is a real three-temperature cube sheet. Verification: node --test calibrate/page/maturity 48 pass; run_workflow_locally --for-changes 9/11 passed, the 2 failures were the unfilled run record (now filled) and the thousands-split check (fixed); Playwright at 390 px: no horizontal overflow, no console errors, example calibrates and 'Use these values' fills the inputs.
